# Dupe

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** Dupe

## What it does

Dupe tries to duplicate items from your inventory by abusing known server-side exploits. When you enable it, the client runs the selected exploit routine in an attempt to clone the items you're carrying, letting you end up with more copies than you started with.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/dupe). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
